faqs.q: Can you repair my refrigerator the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day refrigerator repair is our standard service in Houston and nearby cities. Call or book online and we will schedule a technician to come out the same day.

faqs.q: Is the refrigerator repair estimate free?
faqs.a: Yes. The technician diagnoses the problem and gives you a free estimate before any work starts, so you know the price and can decide whether to go ahead.

faqs.q: What warranty do refrigerator repairs have?
faqs.a: Every refrigerator repair is covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

faqs.q: Do you repair Sub-Zero and other built-in refrigerators?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all major brands, including Sub-Zero, Thermador and Viking built-in and column models, as well as Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, KitchenAid and more.

faqs.q: Why is the freezer cold but the refrigerator section warm?
faqs.a: Cold air reaches the fresh-food side from the freezer. When the evaporator fan stops, the coil ices over because of a defrost fault, or a damper sticks closed, the freezer stays cold while the refrigerator warms up.

faqs.q: Is it worth repairing an older refrigerator?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Fans, relays, thermostats and defrost parts are common, contained repairs. For major failures on an older model we explain the options honestly, and the free estimate lets you compare before you decide.

faqs.q: What should I do with my food while I wait?
faqs.a: Keep the doors closed as much as possible. A closed refrigerator keeps food cold for about four hours and a full freezer for much longer. Move milk, meat and medicine to a cooler with ice if the repair will take longer.
